title: Two model families score target activity

text: Two model families score target activity
Each target model sees the same molecular representation and predicts an activity ranking.

Many decision trees
combine their votes
Good baseline for nonlinear structure–activity patterns.
Each round focuses on errors left by earlier trees.
For TRPV1, CB1 and FAAH, the team compared both using scaffold splits and reported model-specific metrics.

The two classifiers are Random Forest and LightGBM. Output scores are model predictions, not confirmed probabilities of efficacy. Activity labels do not distinguish agonists from antagonists.

Sources: src/featurize.py; src/train.py; results/model_metrics.csv; results/REPORT.md
